rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders (authentication appears attempted via name+ZIP and user details), but then executed returns and a cancellation without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Additionally, the final customer-visible response with the refund total is not shown; while a calculation tool was invoked, the result was not communicated. It’s also unclear if cancel_pending_order cancelled just the hose item or an entire order; given the user’s conditional instruction, this required explicit confirmation. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
